name: Blednye nochi krovavoj likoris
source:
After meeting a dead maiden, the protagonist awakens in a white space. It seemed as if everything that had happened on the wanderer's path had been one big nightmare, but who knew that all subsequent events would be merely a continuation of what had never been resolved in the past...

[From [url=https://rushi13.itch.io/pale-nights-of-bloody-lycoris-eng]itch.io[/url]]
